## Verification

Required when this PR touches `systemd/`, `prompts/`, or `config/`. Run `.agents/skills/verify-fleet/SKILL.md` on the changed unit (or the unit that reads the changed prompt or config) and paste the invocation id, the journal lines for that id, the artifact, `Result`, `CPUUsageNSec`, and `MemoryPeak`.
